import { getCameraPosition, getEffectiveAspectRatio, getViewMatrix, getViewProjectionMatrix, projectWorldToScreen, resolveCameraViewport } from "@babylonjs/lite";

export function labelPosition(camera: Camera, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, point: { x: number; y: number; z: number }): { x: number; y: number; visible: boolean } {
  const backingWidth = canvas.width;
  const backingHeight = canvas.height;
  if (backingWidth <= 0 || backingHeight <= 0) {
    return { x: 0, y: 0, visible: false };
  }
  const viewport = resolveCameraViewport(camera, backingWidth, backingHeight);
  const aspect = getEffectiveAspectRatio(camera, backingWidth, backingHeight);
  const view = getViewMatrix(camera);
  const viewProjection = getViewProjectionMatrix(camera, aspect);
  const options: any = { viewport, backingWidth, backingHeight };
  const cssWidth = canvas.clientWidth;
  const cssHeight = canvas.clientHeight;
  if (cssWidth > 0 && cssHeight > 0) { options.cssWidth = cssWidth; options.cssHeight = cssHeight; }
  else { options.cssWidth = backingWidth; options.cssHeight = backingHeight; }
  if (camera._useFloatingOrigin) {
    const pos = getCameraPosition(camera);
    options.worldOrigin = { x: pos.x, y: pos.y, z: pos.z };
  }
  const projected = projectWorldToScreen(point, view, viewProjection, options);
  const visible = !projected.behindCamera && !projected.offscreen;
  return { x: projected.cssX, y: projected.cssY, visible };
}

  getViewMatrix,

  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
  point: { x: number; y: number; z: number }
): { x: number; y: number; visible: boolean } {

  const backingHeight = canvas.height;

  if (
    backingWidth <= 0 ||
    backingHeight <= 0 ||
    !Number.isFinite(point.x) ||
    !Number.isFinite(point.y) ||
    !Number.isFinite(point.z)
  ) {
    return { x: 0, y: 0, visible: false };
  }

    const viewport = resolveCameraViewport(camera, backingWidth, backingHeight);
    if (viewport.width <= 0 || viewport.height <= 0) {
      return { x: 0, y: 0, visible: false };
    }

    const aspect = getEffectiveAspectRatio(camera, backingWidth, backingHeight);
    if (!Number.isFinite(aspect) || aspect <= 0) {
      return { x: 0, y: 0, visible: false };
    }

    const view = getViewMatrix(camera);
    const viewProjection = getViewProjectionMatrix(camera, aspect);

    let cssWidth = canvas.clientWidth;
    let cssHeight = canvas.clientHeight;
    if (!Number.isFinite(cssWidth) || cssWidth <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(cssHeight) || cssHeight <= 0) {
      cssWidth = backingWidth;
      cssHeight = backingHeight;
    }

    const options = {
      viewport,
      backingWidth,
      backingHeight,
      cssWidth,
      cssHeight,
    } as any;

    if (camera._useFloatingOrigin) {

    const visible = !projected.behindCamera && !projected.offscreen && Number.isFinite(projected.cssX) && Number.isFinite(projected.cssY);

    return { x, y, visible };
  } catch {
    return { x: 0, y: 0, visible: false };

}

import {
  getCameraPosition,
  getEffectiveAspectRatio,
  getViewMatrix,
  getViewProjectionMatrix,

  resolveCameraViewport,
} from "@babylonjs/lite";

  viewport: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number };
  backingWidth: number;
  backingHeight: number;
  cssWidth: number;
  cssHeight: number;
  worldOrigin?: { x: number; y: number; z: number };

export function labelPosition(...): ... {
  if (!camera || !canvas || !point) return {x:0,y:0,visible:false};
  const backingWidth = canvas.width;
  const backingHeight = canvas.height;
  if (!Number.isFinite(backingWidth) || backingWidth <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(backingHeight) || backingHeight <= 0) return ...;
  if (!Number.isFinite(point.x) || ...) return ...;
  try {
    const rawViewport = resolveCameraViewport(camera, backingWidth, backingHeight);
    const viewport = { x: rawViewport.x, y: rawViewport.y, width: rawViewport.width, height: rawViewport.height };
    if (!Number.isFinite(viewport.x) || !Number.isFinite(viewport.y) || !Number.isFinite(viewport.width) || viewport.width <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(viewport.height) || viewport.height <= 0) return ...;
    const aspect = getEffectiveAspectRatio(camera, backingWidth, backingHeight);
    if (!Number.isFinite(aspect) || aspect <= 0) return ...;
    let worldOrigin: ProjectionOptions["worldOrigin"];
    if (camera._useFloatingOrigin) {
      const pos = getCameraPosition(camera);
      worldOrigin = { x: pos.x, y: pos.y, z: pos.z };
    }
    const view = getViewMatrix(camera);
    const viewProjection = getViewProjectionMatrix(camera, aspect);
    let cssWidth = canvas.clientWidth;
    let cssHeight = canvas.clientHeight;
    if (!Number.isFinite(cssWidth) || cssWidth <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(cssHeight) || cssHeight <= 0) {
      cssWidth = backingWidth;
      cssHeight = backingHeight;
    }
    const options: ProjectionOptions = { viewport, backingWidth, backingHeight, cssWidth, cssHeight };
    if (worldOrigin) options.worldOrigin = worldOrigin;
    const projected = projectWorldToScreen(point, view, viewProjection, options);
    const x = Number.isFinite(projected.cssX) ? projected.cssX : 0;
    const y = Number.isFinite(projected.cssY) ? projected.cssY : 0;
    const visible = projected.behindCamera === false && projected.offscreen === false && Number.isFinite(projected.cssX) && Number.isFinite(projected.cssY);
    return { x, y, visible };
  } catch {
    return { x: 0, y: 0, visible: false };
  }
